txt.esta_componente_apenas_est_dispon_ve: This component is only available to administrators.
txt.esta_ferramenta_ainda_n_o_est_dispon: This tool is not yet available on mobile.
txt.escolhe_o_que_queres_criar: Choose what you want to create:
txt.um_mapa_novo_e_independente_para_des: A new, independent map, to draw and edit.
txt.uma_p_gina_com_v_rios_mapas_existent: A page with several existing maps side by side.
txt.escolhe_um_munic_pio_para_veres_os_c: Choose a municipality to see the portal content available to import as a layer in Engenh.
txt.o_mapa_j_est_pronto_configura_o_modo: The map is ready. Set up the work mode and start vectorizing directly on it.
txt.utilize_o_bot_o_importar_no_heather: Use the import button in the header…
txt.sem_liga_o_internet_o_mapa_est_desat: No internet connection. The map is disabled until you reconnect or switch to offline mode with an already saved area.
txt.aproxima_te_rea_de_interesse_no_mapa: Zoom in to the area of interest on the map and click Auto-georeference.
txt.ainda_n_o_configuraste_nenhuma_shape: You haven't set up any shape yet. Use the "Vectorize" button to get started.
txt.uma_linha_por_geometria_o_id_sequenc: One row per geometry. The ID is sequential and is not saved in the GeoJSON.
txt.seleciona_as_camadas_e_o_formato_par: Select the layers and format to download.
txt.ainda_n_o_tens_geometrias_nem_result: You don't have any geometries or analysis results to export yet.
txt.como_queres_trabalhar: How do you want to work?
txt.podes_criar_um_projeto_novo_continua: You can create a new project, continue one already saved on this device, or work without saving.
txt.d_s_um_nome_e_o_trabalho_fica_guarda: Give it a name and the work is saved in the app.
txt.abre_um_projeto_que_j_tens_guardado_: Open a project you already saved on this device.
txt.trabalhas_livremente_nada_guardado_a: You work freely, nothing is saved automatically.
txt.guardados_neste_dispositivo_e_navega: Saved on this device and browser. Opening a project replaces the current geometries on the map with the chosen project's ones.
txt.tens_geometrias_desenhadas_ou_editad: You have drawn or edited geometries that haven't been saved on this device yet. If you leave without saving, this work will be lost.
txt.j_guardaste_este_projeto_manualmente: You've already saved this project manually a few times. Do you want DataGis to save changes automatically from now on?
txt.como_queres_trabalhar_2: How do you want to work?
txt.d_um_nome_a_esta_shape_para_continua: Give this shape a name to continue.
txt.escolhe_se_cada_geometria_desenhada_: Choose whether each drawn geometry will just have a shape, or will have associated attributes (like in QGIS/ArcGIS).
txt.define_at_3_campos_com_classes_prede: Define up to 3 fields, with preset classes if you like.
txt.at_3_atributos_para_categorias_campo: Up to 3 attributes. For categories ("Categorical" field), define the classes and their colors — just like a categorized symbology in QGIS.
txt.um_shapefile_s_pode_conter_um_tipo_d: A shapefile can only contain one geometry type — choose what you'll vectorize in this session.
txt.desenha_um_ret_ngulo_no_mapa_para_de: Draw a rectangle on the map to define the offline area
txt.desenha_uma_linha_no_mapa_para_medir: Draw a line on the map to measure distance
txt.esta_rea_ficar_dispon_vel_no_mapa_me: This area will remain available on the map even without an internet connection, on this device.
txt.tens_uma_rea_guardada_para_trabalho_: You have a saved area for offline work.
txt.desmarca_as_que_n_o_queres_incluir_n: Uncheck the ones you don't want to include in the buffer.
txt.arrasta_o_slider_ou_escreve_o_valor_: Drag the slider or type the exact value.
txt.seleciona_pelo_menos_2_pol_gonos_o_r: Select at least 2 polygons. The result is the area common to all of them.
Select at least 2 polygons. The result merges everything into a single geometry.
txt.esta_a_geometria_que_fica_a_que_vai_: This is the geometry that stays (the one that will be clipped).
txt.o_resultado_a_base_menos_as_geometri: The result is the base minus the marked geometries.
txt.esta_ferramenta_utiliza_intelig_ncia: This tool uses artificial intelligence to automatically detect buildings from orthophoto imagery. The process is simple:
txt.anota_alguns_exemplos_de_edif_cios_e: Annotate some examples of buildings and non-buildings
txt.o_sistema_treina_um_modelo_e_classif: The system trains a model and classifies the area automatically
txt.o_processamento_totalmente_local_os_: Processing is entirely local — your data never leaves your browser.
txt.o_que_pretendes_detetar: What do you want to detect?
txt.seleciona_o_tipo_de_objeto_a_identif: Select the type of object to identify. In this first version, only the "Buildings" option is available.
txt.desenha_um_ret_ngulo_ou_pol_gono_no_: Draw a rectangle or polygon on the map matching the area where you want to detect buildings.
txt.rea_j_bem_coberta_por_edif_cios_osm: Area already well covered by OSM buildings
txt.da_rea_desenhada_j_corresponde_a_edi: % of the drawn area already matches existing buildings in OpenStreetMap (
txt.encontrados_o_classificador_ajuda_so: found). The classifier mainly helps detect buildings that OSM doesn't have yet — for the rest, these buildings are already imported as samples. Consider drawing a smaller area, focused only on uncovered zones.
txt.desenha_pol_gonos_pequenos_sobre_exe: Draw small polygons over examples of
txt.clica_em_edif_cio_ou_n_o_edif_cio_ab: Click "Building" or "Non-building" below, and draw a polygon over the matching example on the map. At least 5 samples of each type are recommended.
txt.o_modelo_est_a_processar_a_rea_de_tr: The model is processing the work area. This may take a few minutes.
txt.rev_os_pol_gonos_detetados_podes_eli: Review the detected polygons. You can delete false positives by clicking on them on the map.
txt.a_camada_foi_criada_automaticamente_: The layer was automatically created in the layers panel.
txt.desenha_um_ret_ngulo_no_mapa_para_de: Draw a rectangle on the map to define the processing area.
txt.desenha_um_pol_gono_sobre_um_edif_ci: Draw a polygon over a building.
txt.encontraste_um_problema_ou_tens_uma_: Found a problem or have a suggestion for the digitizing tool? Leave your feedback, we'll read it carefully.
